profile.summary: LCA Architects is an architecture and planning firm in the San Francisco Bay Area that has operated for over 40 years. It provides design services for affordable housing, residential, education, public safety, commercial, hospitality and industrial projects. It has offices in Walnut Creek and Oakland, California.
